name: Briar Bush Nature Center Summer Camp
operator_name: Briar Bush Nature Center (Abington Township Parks and Recreation)
description_short: Weekly nature camps at Briar Bush's 12.5 acre forest preserve in Abington, with themed half day camps for ages 4 to 6 and full day camps for ages 6 to 7 on site, van travel camps to regional parks and farms for ages 8 to 12, and one overnight camping week at Ricketts Glen State Park for ages 13 to 15.
refund_policy_summary: Transfers or cancellations 15 or more days before the start date get an 80% refund (20% service fee); no transfers or refunds within 14 days of the start.
special_needs_notes: An inclusive program that tries to accommodate campers, but staff are not behavioral intervention professionals and may not manage every medical, behavioral or social need; families are asked to call about support. Campers must be toilet trained and able to communicate their needs.

notes: All prices are the standard (non-resident, non-member) rate. Abington Township residents pay 10% less (for example $279 instead of $310, $400.50 instead of $445) and members at the Robin level and above pay 20% less ($248, $356). price_per_week is a standard five day week of Saplings full day camp; half day Seedlings is $310 and travel camps $490 to $575; four day weeks (June 14 and July 6) cost less. Hours 9:30 to 4:00 (half day 9:30 to 12:00 or 1:30 to 4:00); before care 8:30 to 9:30 ($30 a week) and after care 4:00 to 5:30 ($45 a week). Campers bring lunch; travel camp field trips and the overnight week's travel, lodging and food are included. Members register January 28, 2027 at noon, everyone else January 29.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer Camp Guide 2027 page (same content as the linked 2027 PDF guide). Each week lists a standard price, a Resident price and a Member price; sessions and prices use the standard price. Weeks starting 6/14 and 7/6 are four day weeks. Travel camps are not offered July 19 to 23. Address, phone and info email in the page header; email used is the Program and Summer Camp Director's. Campers pack a lunch; the center gives a snack only if one is forgotten. Financial aid by application using federal poverty guidelines. Briar Bush is part of Abington Township Parks and Recreation.
